messages:
Priya (People Ops): Diego says his EAD showed as delivered but he never got it. Can you paste tracking?
Diego M.: Tracking 9400 5555 6666 7777 delivered 2025-02-05 to building front desk. Concierge says nothing. Filed missing mail ticket MN-2025-5601.
Lina K. (Hiring Manager): We planned a 2025-02-10 start to shadow. Can he begin without the physical card?
ImmigrationBot: USCIS guidance: I-797 approval + EAD receipt can be used temporarily for I-9 in some cases; employer must document and follow up.
Priya (People Ops): Options: delay start; provisional start with attestation + hold pay; or limited unpaid onboarding. Thoughts?
Payroll: If we do provisional start, payroll will set contingent-active and hold direct deposit until physical EAD is presented.
Benefits: If hire is marked active, enrollment window opens. Need clear hire date.
Legal - HR: We can accept I-797 + receipt for provisional I-9. Use our addendum: employee must present original EAD within 90 days or termination.
Diego M.: Uploaded I-797 and USPS ticket. I can provide notarized attestation today.
Priya (People Ops): OK proceeding: mark provisional-active for 2025-02-10, payroll hold set, Benefits to allow enrollment, Legal will prepare addendum with 90-day follow-up. Lina: limit Diego to internal work until EAD sighted.
Lina K. (Hiring Manager): Agreed. Team will do internal shadowing only.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll create follow-up task for 2025-05-11 to verify card. Re-open if USPS updates. :white_check_mark:
